s: Seder motzae yom hakkippurim ubo t"v seipim: umitpalelin tepillat arbit, sheen tepillat neila poteret shel arbit apillu otam hammamshikim bah ballayla, kevan shehizkiru bah shel yom hakkippurim. Veomerim habdala be"chonen haddaat", kemo bekol motzae shabbat veyom tob:

Vetzarik lehosip min hachol al haqqodesh bitziato kemo biknisato kemo shennitbaer besiman tr"ch, dehaynu sheyyamtinu meat achar tzet hakkokabim. Ubimqomot shemmabdilin al hakkos bebet hakkeneset bekol motzae shabbat veyom tob — gam akshav yabdil hashsheliach tzibbur, veyatim min hakkos leqatan, o legadol im mitkavven latzet behabdala zo. Veayyen besiman rtz"h:

Hammabdil al hakkos bemotzae yom hakkippurim — eno mebarek al habbesamim, shello tiqqenu ella bemotzae shabbat kede lehashib et hannepesh yetera shehaleka lah. Abal im chal yom hakkippurim beshabbat — mebarekin al habbesamim kemo bekol motzae shabbat:

Abal al haur tzarik lebarek apillu keshechal bechol, lepi shehu dabar chadash shello nehena mimmennu beyom hakkippurim sheasur behabara, lepikak eno domeh lishar motzae yom tob sheen mebarekin alayv, lepi sheen mebarekin al haur ella bishat chiddusho, dehaynu bemotzae shabbat shehu techillat beriyyato, o bemotzae yom hakkippurim shehu kemo dabar chadash lanu kemo shennitbaer:

Veen mebarekin bemotzae yom hakkippurim al haur shehotziuhu atta bemotzae yom hakkippurim min haabanim o min haetzim, velo al haur shehudlaq meur zeh, ella al ur sheshshabat mimmelaka, kegon ashashit shehayeta doleqet veholeket meereb yom kippur. Veap al pi shebbemotzae shabbat mebarekin al haur hayyotze min haabanim veetzim, haynu lepi shettechillat beriyyato bemotzae shabbat hayeta al derek zeh, shennatal adam harishon shene abanim vehiqqishan zeh bazeh veyatza ur uberak alayv "bore meore haesh", laken mebarekin bemotzae shabbat al kol ur shebbaolam (ella im ken naasa bo melaka beshabbat kemo shennitbaer besiman rch"tz) apillu yatza atta min haabanim, lepi shezzehu keen beriyyato, abal bemotzae yom hakkippurim shettaam birkato hu lepi shepposqa hanaato bo bayyom veakshav huttar lo — en lebarek ella al ur sheshshabat mammash, dehaynu shehudlaq meereb yom kippur veshabat kol yom hakkippurim. Vaapillu im chal yom hakkippurim beshabbat — en mebarek bemotzae shabbat ella al haur shehudlaq meereb yom kippur veshabat kol yom hakkippurim, kede leharot sheyyom zeh hu mequddash sheshshabat min haur:

Yisrael shehidliq miggoy bemotzae yom hakkippurim — en mebarekin alayv, mippene sheuro shel goy naasa bo melaka shehudlaq beyom hakkippurim. Veap al pi shebbemotzae shabbat mebarekin alayv, lepi shehu mebarek al tosepet shalhebet shel hetter shennitvassep benero shel yisrael, mikkol maqom bemotzae yom hakkippurim — en mebarek alayv, lepi shettosepet shalhebet zo hi noleda akshav, vedomeh leur hayyotze min haabanim bemotzae yom kippur sheen mebarekin alayv, velo al haur shehudlaq mimmennu, ella al haur sheddalaq meereb yom kippur o al haur shehudlaq mimmennu. Velaken nohagin lehadliq ner lahabdala meashashiyyot shel bet hakkeneset sheddalequ meereb yom kippur:

Umikkol maqom apillu ur shehudlaq beyom kippur atzmo, im hudlaq behetter kegon lecholeh — yekolim lebarek alayv bemotzae yom hakkippurim kemo shemmebarekin alayv bemotzae shabbat kemo shennitbaer besiman rch"tz:

Ap al pi shemmin haddin muttar lebarek bemotzae yom hakkippurim al haur shehudlaq min haur sheshshabat, dehaynu shehudlaq meereb yom kippur kemo shennitbaer, mikkol maqom tob lehachamir ulebarek al ur sheshshabat mibbeod yom mammash. Umikkol maqom lo yebarek al nerot shel bet hakkeneset beatzman ap al pi shehudlequ mibbeod yom, lepi shello hudlequ raq likbod hayyom velikbod bet hakkeneset velo bishbil lehair, veen mebarekin ella al haur shehudlaq lehair kemo shennitbaer besiman rch"tz, ella madliq ner echad minner shel bet hakkeneset haddoleq meereb yom kippur vibarek al shenehem beyachad. Veim i epshar lo lehabdil al shenehem beyachad — yabdil al ner shehidliq min nerot shel bet hakkeneset shehudlequ mibbeod yom, velo yabdil al nerot shel bet hakkeneset bilbad. Veim abar uberak al nerot shel bet hakkeneset bilbad ap al pi shehudlequ lekabod — ap al pi ken en tzarik lachazor ulebarek al ner acher, kevan sheasuyin gam lehair, shehare mitpalelin leoran:
Veokelin usemechin bemotzae yom kippur, mishshum shehu qetzat yom tob kemo shennitbaer besiman trk"g, ubat qol yotzet bemotzae yom kippur veomeret "lek ekol besimcha":

Yesh anshe maaseh shemmachamirin laasot yom kippur shene yamim kemo sheanu osim shene yamim tobim baggola bishar kol hammoadot, umi shennahag chumra zo verotzeh leshannot minhago — tzarik hattara kemo neder. Abal en linhog chumra zo, mishshum sheyyesh lachosh lesakkana, veod shehare akshav shebbatel qiddush hachodesh al pi hareiyya anu beqiim becheshbon qebiut hechodashim, veanu omerim sheelul leolam chaser veyom rishon shel rosh hashshana hu rosh chodesh tishre ubeasor lachodesh hu yom hakkippurim shellanu, veen anu osin shear kol hammoadot shene yamim ella kede shello leshannot mimminhag abotenu shehayu bizman shehayu meqaddeshim hechodashim al pi hareiyya velo hayu yodeim yom shenniret bo hallebana veniqba bo rosh hashshana beeretz yisrael, veim ken beyom hakkippurim ap abotenu lo asu ella yom echad mechamat chashash sakkana, sheen gozerin al hatztzibbur ella im ken rob hatztzibbur yekolin laamod bah, im ken lamma lanu lehachamir ulehitannot bechinnam:

Veotan haosin shene yamim yom hakkippurim apillu hem asara beyachad — ap al pi ken lo yeshannu mittepillot shel chol, shekkol hammitpallel tepilla shello tiqqenuhu chakamim lazzeman hahu — hare zeh mebarek lebattala, ak bislichot upiyyutim yomru kirtzonam, kevan sheen sham beraka lebattala, ubilbad sheyyomru otam achar siyyum tepillatam, abal lo yapsiqu baamiratam beemtza hattepilla apillu keshemmitpalelin batztzibbur shellahem:

Ukeshechal yom hakkippurim beyom chamishi — asur lahem lehakin tzorke shabbat apillu al yede acherim o al yede goy, kevan shehen machaziqin yom zeh leyom hakkippurim, ak yoklu beshabbat im acherim shello hirbu lebashshel bishbilam, abal im goy bishshel beyom zeh letzorko, im hu makkir otam — asurim leekol mibbishshulo, apillu im siyya immo yisrael beinyan sheen bo mishshum bishshule goyim, gezera shemma yarbeh haggoy bashshana habbaa lebashshel gam bishbilam, abal yisrael hambashshel bishbil atzmo — en lachosh shemma yarbeh lebashshel gam bishbilam, shemmin hassetam lo yaabor al lav de"lipne ivver lo titten mikshol", velo yaakil otam mibbishshulo, kevan shehem machaziqin yom zeh leyom kippur:
Hayyamim shebben yom hakkippurim lesukkot hen yeme simcha, shebbahen hayu mechannekin et hammizbeach bime shelomoh, lepikak en mitannin bahen apillu yom mitat ab vaem, veen omerim tachanun:
Bayyom sheachar yom hakkippurim — mashkimin lebet hakkeneset:

(Kol haddebarim haasurim beyom hakkippurim mechamat mitzvat innuy, kegon rechitza vesika uneilat hassandal — muttarim miyyad achar shehosip meat mechol al haqqodesh, apillu lo hibdil adayin battepilla, chutz meakila ushetiyya, shello aseru qodem habdala ella akila ushetiyya vaasiyyat melaka mammash, kemo shennitbaer besiman rtz"t, ayyen sham):
